entities.name: Chaeska
entities.description: The strongest of Lim-Dul's undead minions, castellan of Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: A necromancer whose undead legions fought Kjeldor and Balduvia.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: The keep Chaeska built on the site of the former Conclave of Mages.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A prisoner at Tresserhorn who severed Chaeska's arm.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A mage who rescued Jodah and fought Chaeska.

entities.name: Marton Stromgald
entities.description: Dismantled; Chaeska wielded his sword arm.

entities.name: Lord of Tresserhorn
entities.description: An undead replacement for Lim-Dul built by Chaeska and destroyed by Jodah.

entities.name: Knights of Stromgald
entities.description: Order that overpowered Chaeska and took over Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Nation that defeated Lim-Dul's legions with Balduvia.

entities.name: Balduvia
entities.description: Nation that defeated Lim-Dul's legions with Kjeldor.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: United forces that tore down Tresserhorn.

events.summary: Chaeska builds Tresserhorn and becomes its castellan.
events.quote: He became castellan of the keep, the citadel's governor in its master's absence.

events.summary: Jaya comes to rescue the prisoner Jodah; Chaeska catches them, but Jodah severs his arm and sets him on fire.
events.quote: Jodah severed one of his arms and set him on fire before he fled back to Lim-Dûl.

events.summary: At Lim-Dul's Battle Chaeska faces Jaya, who uses Unsummon to send him back to Tresserhorn.
events.quote: she used blue mana and cast Unsummon on him, returning him directly to the halls to Tresserhorn.

events.summary: After Lim-Dul's defeat Chaeska builds the Lord of Tresserhorn to keep the undead from rebelling.
events.quote: Chaeska constructed an undead replacement for Lim-Dûl dubbed the Lord of Tresserhorn

events.summary: Jodah destroys the Lord of Tresserhorn, and Chaeska promises not to harm them.
events.quote: Jodah was forced to destroy it by blasting a hole in its chest.

events.summary: The Knights of Stromgald overpower Chaeska and take over Tresserhorn.
events.quote: The Knights of Stromgald eventually overpowered Chaeska and his skeletal guard
